exposure: Ultrasonographic measurement of skin-to-lumbar epidural space depth via parasagittal oblique view
Ultrasonographic measurement of skin-to-lumbar epidural space depth via transverse median view
outcome: Depth from the skin to the lumbar epidural space
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: The mean skin-to-lumbar epidural space depth in pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section was 46.84 mm in the parasagittal oblique view and 45.27 mm in the transverse median view, which was comparable to findings from other similar studies.
